'Either Battle plan or Menace Fades' is posted once in the starting section and once under Effects; each is printed as written (one card either way) and counted, giving 60.
The description says the deck 'is undefeated in three tounaments' but names no event, so it stays a general deck.

Posted 'Nobel Sac' dested Noble Sacrifice; 'OofC/TT' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Weapon Lev' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace); 'Lukes Stick' dested Luke's Lightsaber; 'Lando w/axe' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Wedge Antillies' dested the Premiere Wedge Antilles; 'Captin Han Solo' dested Captain Han Solo; 'Night Fall' dested Nightfall.
Patrol Craft x2 is posted under 'Blue6' (starships); the card is a Vehicle. The section headers 'Admirals Orders2', 'Green3' (weapons) and 'Blue6' (starships) are not cards.
Credited to the existing page Nate Meeker (2006 World Champion) as the same name, as for his other April 2001 posts.

Same list as Nate Meeker's DeckTech 15041 ('This Ground Sure Fells Strange Better WYS', 4 April 2001), which reposts this one. His Ohio States runner-up list (15518 / 15581, 23 and 26 April 2001) is the same except What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? in place of Out Of Nowhere.
